summary: The note describes the Type 639, a class of ocean surveillance ship that was the newest Chinese oceanographic surveillance ship as of mid-2014, built for the People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN). One unit with pennant number Bei-diao 991 serves as an oceanographic research ship, and five modified versions used as hydrographic survey ships are designated Type 639A.
one_line: Type 639 is China's newest oceanographic surveillance ship class (as of mid-2014) built for the PLAN, with a Type 639A hydrographic variant.
key_facts: The Type 639 is an ocean surveillance ship class developed by China for its People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN).
As of mid-2014, the Type 639 was the newest oceanographic surveillance ship developed by China.
A single Type 639 unit with pennant number Bei-diao 991 is in service as an oceanographic research ship.
Five modified versions of the Type 639 serve as hydrographic survey ships.
The modified hydrographic survey versions are designated Type 639A.
The Type 639 is developed for the People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN).
